acceptanceCriteria: A complete receipt emitted by finalize-recovery-plan can be applied as the first direct_merge_no_pr canonical record when all human-owned identity fields are correct.
The validator reports the exact mismatched resource-context category and remains fail-closed for branch, worktree, base, repository, Work Item, Git parent, and runtime identity changes.
Regression tests cover preserved legacy Contract context and generated historical context, prove predecessor bytes are unchanged, and prove no partial record is written on rejection.
The commands and three-language docs describe deterministic fields versus human-owned fields without requiring trial-and-error or fabricated PR data.
goal: Fix the Runtime compatibility path reported by the adopter repository, add end-to-end regression coverage for first-record direct-merge apply using both preserved contract context and generated historical context, and document the exact human-owned fields.
intent: Make historical direct-merge recovery applyable from the read-only plan with deterministic identity diagnostics and no mutation of predecessor bytes.
outOfScope: unrelated lifecycle or reference parity changes
release redesign beyond the resulting patch version
